messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info

message.content:
The largest planet that astronomers have confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 (about 320 light‑years away) and has a radius of roughly **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter** (≈ 200,000 km). Its mass is estimated to be a few times that of Jupiter as well, making it one of the most massive “super‑Jupiter” planets known.

> *Note:* The universe is vast, and new exoplanets are being discovered all the time. While HD 100546 b is the largest confirmed planet to date, future observations may reveal even larger worlds.
